# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [MiniMax H3 Community Builds Cut Video Generation Costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/minimax-h3-community-video-audio.html): New community contributions show MiniMax H3 generating reference-controlled video and audio in as few as four to eight denoising steps.
- [Tencent Open-Sources Low-Latency Simultaneous Translation Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy-simulmt-open-source.html): Tencent has released Hy-SimulMT, an open Chinese-English simultaneous interpretation model designed to deliver accurate speech translation with roughly three seconds of latency.
- [Tsinghua Open-Sources AKV to Cut Agent Inference Costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tsinghua-akv-agent-cache.html): Tsinghua and CUHK researchers released AKV, an Apache-licensed SGLang server that reduces agent inference costs by editing KV cache visibility.
- [Nvidia opens Flora to cut robot-video labeling costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-flora-robot-data-engine.html): Nvidia has open-sourced Flora, a robotics data engine that labels 200,000 hours daily and claims a 125-fold cost advantage over GPT-6 Astra.
- [Cursor gives coding agents control of desktop apps](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-computer-use-desktop-agents.html): Cursor’s new Computer Use feature lets coding agents click and type across desktop software, including simulators used to test mobile apps.
- [Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with 3T-class scale](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/kimi-k31-pro-launches.html): Moonshot’s new Kimi K3.1 Pro combines a 1M-token context window, tool use and multimodal workflows with immediate API access.
- [OpenAI removes live internet from frontier training](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-frontier-training-offline.html): OpenAI says its frontier-model training environments will no longer use the live internet after security testing exposed containment weaknesses.
- [Apple Makes Xcode Projects Easier for Coding Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/apple-xcode-json-agent-projects.html): Xcode 27.2 adopts a smaller JSON project format designed to reduce merge conflicts and make automated code editing safer.
- [Canva Releases Craft, Its First In-House Image Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/canva-craft-image-model.html): Canva has launched Craft, a design-focused image model that plans composition before rendering and is available in Canva and through a public API.
- [OpenAI Reportedly Nears $30 Billion Pre-IPO Funding](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-30-billion-funding-round.html): OpenAI is reportedly seeking a $30 billion bridge round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, underscoring the capital demands of frontier AI.
- [OpenAI Makes Decisions API Generally Available for Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-decisions-api-general-availability.html): OpenAI has released a low-cost endpoint for bounded choices, aiming to make real-time routing and agent control faster and cheaper.
- [Sakana AI Unveils Aquarium for Organizational Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/sakana-aquarium-agent-platform.html): Sakana AI has introduced Aquarium, an ontology-based platform designed to connect organizational knowledge with agent decisions and execution.
- [StartLux Open-Sources Prism for Faster Decision Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/startlux-prism-decision-inference.html): StartLux releases Prism, an open inference engine for its calibrated decision models, with reported speedups of up to 5.3x in selected workloads.
- [Anthropic Opens Claude Duet as a Proactive AI Agent](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-claude-duet-agent.html): Anthropic is testing Claude Duet, an agent that monitors priorities, completes tasks and asks for approval before sensitive actions.
- [IBM Releases Open Granite Time-Series Ensemble Recipe](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ibm-granite-forecasting-ensemble.html): IBM Research publishes an open forecasting recipe that combines four Granite time-series models for zero-shot and probabilistic prediction.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [MiniMax H3社区方案将视频生成推向低步数推理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/minimax-h3-community-video-audio.html): MiniMax展示H3社区的新方案，可用4至8步去噪生成受参考素材控制的视频与音频，降低推理成本。
- [腾讯开源低延迟中英同传模型 Hy-SimulMT](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy-simulmt-open-source.html): 腾讯混元开源 Hy-SimulMT，面向中英实时同声传译，主打约三秒延迟和可部署的开放模型能力。
- [清华开源 AKV，降低长程智能体推理成本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tsinghua-akv-agent-cache.html): 清华与香港中文大学团队开源 AKV，通过管理智能体的 KV 缓存可见性，在多项测试中平均降低推理成本 27.7%。
- [英伟达开源Flora，机器人视频标注成本降125倍](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-flora-robot-data-engine.html): 英伟达开源机器人数据引擎Flora，称其每天可处理20万小时数据，标注成本约为GPT-6 Astra的八分之一百二十五，即约低125倍。
- [Cursor让编程代理接管桌面应用操作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-computer-use-desktop-agents.html): Cursor推出Computer Use，让编程代理可点击和输入桌面软件，并操作iOS模拟器测试刚生成的功能。
- [月之暗面发布3T级旗舰模型Kimi K3.1 Pro](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/kimi-k31-pro-launches.html): 月之暗面推出Kimi K3.1 Pro，支持百万级上下文、工具调用和多模态工作流，并同步开放API。
- [OpenAI将前沿模型训练改为断开互联网](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-frontier-training-offline.html): OpenAI宣布前沿模型训练环境不再接入实时互联网，此举源于安全测试暴露出的隔离缺陷。
- [苹果让 Xcode 项目文件更适合编程代理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/apple-xcode-json-agent-projects.html): Xcode 27.2 默认采用更小、更清晰的 JSON 项目格式，旨在减少合并冲突并提升自动化改项目的安全性。
- [Canva发布首款自研图像模型Craft，先规划后生成](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/canva-craft-image-model.html): Canva推出面向设计场景的Craft图像模型，现已在Canva和公开API中提供，重点提升构图、文字与版式控制。
- [报道称OpenAI拟融资300亿美元，估值或达1.25万亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-30-billion-funding-round.html): 据报道，OpenAI正筹备一轮300亿美元过桥融资，目标估值约1.25万亿美元，为潜在IPO补充资金。
- [OpenAI正式开放决策API，瞄准实时代理控制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-decisions-api-general-availability.html): OpenAI推出面向有限选项判断的低价API，让代理路由、分类和实时语音控制更快、更便宜。
- [Sakana AI发布Aquarium，用本体驱动企业代理决策](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/sakana-aquarium-agent-platform.html): Sakana AI推出Aquarium平台，以组织本体统一分散信息，连接证据核验、决策判断与实际执行。
- [StartLux发布 Prism，专为决策模型提速](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/startlux-prism-decision-inference.html): StartLux发布面向校准决策模型的推理引擎 Prism，称其在特定测试任务中最高可实现 5.3 倍加速。
- [Anthropic开放Claude Duet主动式代理研究预览](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-claude-duet-agent.html): Anthropic开始测试Claude Duet，让代理主动发现待办、执行任务，并在敏感操作前请求用户批准。
- [IBM开源Granite时序模型集成预测方案](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ibm-granite-forecasting-ensemble.html): IBM研究院发布Granite Timeseries Ensemble R1，将四款时序模型组合到统一接口中，支持零样本和概率预测。

## Pages

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-10-26.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
